newsitem.title: USA: CBOT beans called up 15 to 20 cents on USDA data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT beans called up 15 to 20 cents on USDA data.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were expected to open 15 to 20 cents per bushel higher on bullish stocks and production data from USDA, traders said.
Its final 1996 soybean crop estimate was 2.382 billion bushels. That figure fell below trade expectations and USDA's previous forecast of 2.403 billion bushels.
Traders also said the government's move to lower the soybean carryout to 155 million bushels from 180 million was a signal that U.S. soybean supplies were much tighter than orginally thought.
